notes: Official Yealink datasheet for the original RoomPanel (8-inch, Android 9, 10-point touch meeting-room scheduling panel), fetched directly from www.yealink.com (yealink.com blocks generic WebFetch bot UAs with 403, so it was retrieved via curl with a browser user-agent; content is the authentic manufacturer PDF, not a mirror). This is a scheduling/control touch panel, not a video source or display — it has no HDMI/video I/O; its only physical connectors are Ethernet, USB-C, and 12V DC power, all confirmed in the "Connectivity" and "Power Supply" spec sections. A "1 x Reset pinhole" recessed button also exists but is not a signal/power connector and is omitted. Ethernet is graded eth-100m per the explicitly stated "10/100Mbps Fast Ethernet" spec. Not rack-mountable (wall/box/glass-mounted device), so rackUnits is omitted. Note: Yealink also sells newer variants "RoomPanel Plus" and "RoomPanel E2" (Android 13) with near-identical connectivity specs (1x Fast Ethernet, 1x USB-C, PoE 802.3af + 12V adapter) — this entry is specifically the original "RoomPanel" model per the user's request, confirmed via its own dedicated datasheet PDF.

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: Also carries Power-over-Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af) — this is the same physical port, not a separate power connector.

ports.name: USB-C
ports.note: Datasheet lists only '1 x USB-C port' with no version/speed spec, so no bandwidth grade is set.

ports.name: DC Power
ports.note: Datasheet specifies '12V Power Adapter' but does not name the physical connector; dc-barrel is inferred as the standard form factor for this class of device (closest match in the allowed connector list).
